game_title: Function Test Arena – Skating Pond Defense
game_concept: A tower defense set in Snowy Hold – Skating Pond, a frozen skating pond: the firewood keeper must handle frost imps while practicing functions. Core idea – Function Test Arena: Write quick assert tests to confirm functions behave before facing frost imps.
theme: Snowy Hold – Skating Pond: a frozen skating pond
core_gameplay_loop: In Skating Pond, repeat each round: Write quick assert tests to confirm functions behave before facing frost imps. Each round, frost imps strike the chapel bell, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the tests_passed value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the chapel bell from frost imps in Skating Pond: keep the tests_passed meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 36-second timer ends.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: tests_passed drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 36-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 3 (intro tier): Function Test Arena
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
